meta.geography: Andersonville — Clark St between Foster Ave (5200N) and Bryn Mawr Ave (5600N), Chicago IL 60640

processed.name: Nobody's Darling
processed.notes: Black woman-owned LGBTQ+ cocktail bar, opened 2021. Strong recurring programming: DJ nights (soul, Latin fusion), book clubs, film screenings, LGBTQ+ mixer (monthly). Happy hours Wed-Thu 5-7pm, Fri 4-6pm, Sat 2-4pm, Sun all day. Homepage has embedded event calendar with flyer images. Well-known Andersonville anchor.

processed.name: Elixir Andersonville
processed.notes: Craft cocktail lounge. Strong day-specific specials: Mon $11 martinis, Tue $2 off seasonal, Wed half-price wine bottles, Thu $7 Deep Eddy/Altos. Mon-Fri HH 4-6pm. Sat-Sun 12-2pm bubbly HH. Events page (WordPress, likely JS-rendered) has recurring events incl. Piano Karaoke Tues 9pm, Survivor Watch Party Wed 7pm, DJ nights Fri-Sat, Bubbles & Brunch Sat-Sun.

processed.name: Uvae Kitchen & Wine Bar
processed.notes: Wine bar and fromagerie. Consistent Saturday afternoon wine tastings 3-4:30pm (various themes: Viognier, Slovenian, Greek, Rosé). Monthly wine dinners Monday evenings 6:30-8:30pm. Happy hours Tue-Fri 5-6:30pm, Sat-Sun 3-6:30pm. SpotApps SSR means no Playwright needed. Events page loads cleanly with dated event listings.

Recurring free events: Trivia Wed (Whaddayaknow?), Pop-up Karaoke (varies), Cougar Bingo (monthly, Aunt Nance), Y'All's Brunch drag show (monthly). Events at carolspub.com/music.html as dynamic HTML with artist photos — not flyer images, so Claude may have less visual content to work from.
